Avoid this place. They push unnecessary or premature repairs and aren’t looking out for your best interests. Another shop fixed it in minutes with a computer adjustment for just $85. They even lied to my face, claiming that a computer fix wasn’t possible anywhere. Following their advice would’ve probably cost me another $1K+ at least, all unnecessary work. Learn from my mistake, they are unethical.

Having never worked on an engine before, I was able to get the parts from O'Reily's (thanks guys on Geary, you rock!) and do it for under $1k and it took only 3 hours vs the 6.5 hours the "pros" at AA quoted me.
